generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as reserved 2A Category as prescribed in the tender document

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Satisfactorily completed (at least 25% of the contract value), as prime contractor, at least any work is to be completed of value not less than 25% estimated value of contract
Valid contractor Registration Certificate issued from competent authority in appropriate contractor class

Financial Turnover Certificate obtained and certified by the Registered Valid Chartered Accountant indicating the Registration no of Chartered Accountant with UDIN number details along with profit and loss statement tallying the annual Turnover
Unconditional Line of credit i.e, 30% of amount put to tender obtained from Nationalised/Scheduled Banks in Given Pro-forma in the bid document
Valid PAN Card and Valid GST Registration certificates
Contractor Contact phone number , address and e-mail id are mandatory

The contractor belonging to the 2A Catagory shall be domicile of the State Government of Karnataka for more than 10 years. Hence Relevant Domicile Certificate of bidder for applying to work shall be scanned and upload in e-tender document

itemList.itemCode: code Vol- 1 Page no. 5 Item no. 1.4.1
itemList.description: Earth work excavation by manual means for drains,canals, waste weir, draft, approach channels, key trenches, foundation of bridges andsuch simillar works in all kinds of soils , as per drawing and technical specifications, including setting out, shoring, strutting, barricading, caution lights, removal of stumps and other deleterious matter, excavated surface leveled and sides neatly dressed disposing off the excavated stuff or sorting & stacking the selected stuff for reuse in a radius of 50 m and lift upto 1.5 m including cost of labour, tools & other appurtenaces required to complete the work. (UNI SR 2023-24 Vol-I / Page No.5 / Item No.1.4.1)

itemList.itemCode: code Vol- 1 Page no. 15 Item no. 2.1.3
itemList.description: Providing and laying in position Cement Concrete for levelling course for all works in foundation. The granite/trap/basalt crushed graded coarse aggregates and fine aggregates as per relevant IS Codes machine mixed, laid in layers not exceeding 150 mm thickness, well compacted using plate vibrators, including all lead & lifts, cost of all materials of quality, labour, Usage charges of machinery, curing, and all the other appurtenances required to complete the work as per technical specifications. Mix 1:3:6 Using 40 mm nominal size graded crushed coarse aggregates. (UNI SR 2023-24 Vol-I / Page No.59 / Item No.2.1.3)

itemList.itemCode: code Vol- 1 Page no. 16 Item no. 2.4.2
itemList.description: Providing and laying in position Cement Concrete for all Sub structures of building, Irrigation works, Sub structure works of bridges, Drain works & other parallel works from 0.50m to 3.50 m height. The granite/trap/basalt crushed graded coarse aggregates and fine aggregates as per relevant IS Codes machine mixed with super plasticisers, laid in layers, well compacted using needle vibrators, providing weep holes wherever necessary, including all lead & lifts, cost of all materials of quality, confirming to the requirements of relevant IS codes, labour, Usage charges of machinery, curing and all other appurtenances required to complete the work as per technical specifications. M20 Design Mix Using 20 mm nominal size graded crushed coarse aggregates. (UNI SR 2023-24 Vol-I / Page No.16 / Item No.2.4.2)

itemList.itemCode: code Vol- 1 Page no. 115 Item no. 4
itemList.description: As per recommendations of Technical working group, rates for formwork shall be added on percentage basis to the finished concrete item rate. For Cement Concrete Drain Walls consider 35% (UNI SR 2023-24 Vol-I / Page No.111 / Item No. Addendum I - 4 )

itemList.itemCode: code Vol- 1 Page no. 18 Item no. 2.11 c
itemList.description: Steel Fabrication Supplying, fitting and placing TMT FE 550 / 550D Steel Reinforcement including cost of all materials, machinery, labour, cleaning, straightening, cutting, bending, hooking, laping/welding joints, tying with binding wire / soft annealed steel wire and other ancilary operations complete as per drawing and technical specification. Sub structure of Bridges (UNI SR 2023-24 Vol-I / Page No.18 / Item No.2.11 c )
